foragePerPerson.label: Food foraged per person per turn, before crowding

landCapacity.label: How many foragers the land feeds before returns thin out

weatherSwing.label: How far a turn's foraging can swing up or down (0.15 = 15%)

eatPerPerson.label: Food eaten per person per turn

spoilage.label: Share of stored food lost per turn

growthRate.label: Population growth per turn when fed and sheltered

growthReserve.label: Turns of food in store needed before the population grows

baseCapacity.label: People who can live without built shelter

starvationRate.label: Share of the unfed who die in a famine turn

famineUnrest.label: Stability lost in a famine turn

laborEnergy.label: Energy (labor and firewood) gathered per person per turn

knowledgePerPerson.label: Knowledge gained per person per turn

knowledgeDecay.label: Share of knowledge forgotten per turn

stabilityRest.label: Stability the group drifts toward when nothing pushes it

stabilityPull.label: How fast stability drifts back toward rest

unrestThreshold.label: Below this stability, people start leaving

armsRaceInterval.label: Turns between border decisions with a rival

firstArmsTurn.label: Turn of the first border decision

armsCost.label: Food spent each time you build arms

armsUpkeep.label: Food per turn to keep each level of arms

raidLoss.label: Share of stored food lost when you disarm and they build

tribute.label: Food gained when you build and they disarm

securityToStability.label: Stability change per security point above or below 2

trustGain.label: Trust a rival gains when you disarm

trustLoss.label: Trust a rival loses when you build

treatyBreakPenalty.label: Extra trust lost for building after pledging to disarm
